name: openpixo/retro-low-poly
title: Retro 32-bit 3D
description: Late-1990s console 3D with chunky texels, warped textures and dense fog; a natural fit for lo-fi horror and mystery.

description_i18n.en: Late-1990s console 3D with chunky texels, warped textures and dense fog; a natural fit for lo-fi horror and mystery.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 九十年代末主机 3D 质感：粗颗粒贴图、扭曲纹理与浓雾，适合低保真恐怖和悬疑游戏。

examples.title: Roadside motel at night
examples.prompt: Generate a roadside motel exterior concept using the retro-low-poly art style: a single-storey row of doors, one flickering sodium lamp, a parked boxy car and thick fog swallowing the road. Keep the building silhouette readable from a fixed game camera.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 retro-low-poly 美术风格生成一张公路汽车旅馆外景概念图：一排单层客房门、一盏闪烁的钠灯、一辆方正的老式汽车，浓雾吞没道路。在固定游戏机位下保持建筑轮廓清晰可读。

examples.title: Investigation props
examples.prompt: Create four matching item props using the retro-low-poly art style: a handheld flashlight, a cassette tape, a rusted key on a ring and a small first-aid tin. Use very low polygon counts, tiny nearest-neighbor textures and vertex lighting.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 retro-low-poly 美术风格制作四个配套道具：手电筒、磁带、挂在钥匙圈上的生锈钥匙和小急救盒。使用极低面数、最近邻采样的小尺寸贴图和顶点光照。

style.prompt: Late-1990s 32-bit console 3D game render: very low polygon models, small low-resolution textures with visible blocky texels and no texture filtering, slight affine texture warping across large polygons, faint vertex wobble, vertex-colored Gouraud lighting and limited color depth with soft ordered dithering. Short draw distance fading into dense colored fog, a low internal resolution upscaled with nearest-neighbor. Quiet, slightly uncanny mood; keep the focal silhouette readable against the fog.
style.negativePrompt: modern PBR materials, high polygon count, smooth subdivision surfaces, sharp high-resolution textures, bilinear texture smoothing, ray-traced reflections, soft global illumination, anti-aliasing, depth of field, lens flare, photorealism, explicit gore, text, logo, watermark

constraints.outline: No ink contour; flat-shaded polygon silhouettes separate from the fog.
